lines.description: Today's Rome as an ink map: the river bend, faint modern streets
Dawn mist over a slow river between low hills; a small boat
Ink map: the Tiber glows as it bends through the site
Close on the hills by the river: a first settlement washes in around the Palatine
lines.text: 相传公元前753年，罗马在此建城。

lines.description: The neighbouring hill and the valley between them appear on the map
The settled area spreads beyond the first hill
River landscape with a working boat drifting downstream
The city wash keeps growing to a whole district
The Forum pulses as the centre of the republic
lines.text: 它成了罗马共和国的中心。

lines.description: A wider wash starts beyond the republican city
The imperial city spreads to its full extent; monuments appear
lines.text: 然后，是罗马帝国的中心。

lines.description: The map pans across the full imperial city to the river bank
The two characters for Rome brushed in large ink, then a seal
lines.text: 一个帝国的中心，就在这里。

lines.description: Wide view of the whole ancient city on the river
The imperial city under a cinnabar wash with embers
lines.text: 据记载，410年罗马遭西哥特人洗劫。

lines.description: The city wash shrinks; old centres turn grey
A small town gathers in the river bend
An empty boat on a grey river in thick mist
Across the river, a great church appears; the town is renewed
lines.text: 据记载，15世纪起，教皇推动城市更新。

lines.description: The town spreads again over the old city
Modern streets fade in on both banks
lines.text: 今天的街道，一条条浮现。

lines.description: The whole modern city spreads to the frame edges
Back to the historic centre; its monuments pulse
lines.text: 1980年，罗马历史中心列入世界遗产。

lines.description: The Tiber glows through the modern city
Dawn river again, the same view as the opening
lines.text: 每座城市，都有它的一生。

lines.description: One character for city brushed large, then a seal
lines.text: 你的城市，又是从哪里开始？
